result.reason: The redline provides the fallback 90-day Deliverable conformity period and retains repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies. It does not expressly provide either the preferred 12-month software period or a 90-day/30-day Services warranty period. It also omits the required compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code warranties, so neither level is complete. Because no complete level is reached, the redline is not minimal under the stated definition. It otherwise preserves the existing remedy structure and does not introduce a direct contradiction, although the overlap between the undated Section 19.1 conformity warranty and the 90-day Section 19.2 warranty leaves duration unnecessarily ambiguous.
